decision: continued the existing isolated SSE probe branch
why: The branch already had a browser probe and version matrix, so extending the measured artifact was faster to review than starting over

decision: aligned current and minimum-native cohorts with the project LangChain Core pin
why: LangGraph 1.0.5 resolves with LangChain Core 1.2.2 in the project lockfile; the unpinned probe had resolved 1.7.0

decision: tested FastAPI 0.135.0, 0.161.1, Next.js 16.1.0 and 16.4.2, and LangGraph 1.2.16
why: The native FastAPI SSE threshold and current registry releases needed separate checks before recommending an upgrade
result: isolated versions did not remove rewrite buffering

decision: modeled the production stream without cache or proxy-buffering headers
why: The production /stream/{thread_id} handler returns StreamingResponse without those headers, so a probe with explicit headers was not representative
result: rewrite buffered in all 5 repetitions; direct and Route Handler stayed incremental

decision: added a stream-specific Cache-Control no-transform response policy in the probe
why: The same no-header production model passed when intermediaries were told not to transform the stream

decision: kept the recommendation to retain browser direct REST/SSE and use a Next proxy only for an explicit server boundary
why: The direct path passed, while a rewrite adds compression and proxy behavior that must be configured and tested
result: recommendation ready; deployed ingress remains open

decision: recorded the production ownership and replay limits separately from transport
why: The SSE route authenticates the user but does not call the existing owner check, and content.delta advances a cursor without a replay record
result: follow-up required; not a reason to add Next.js proxy

decision: accepted the measured recommendation and recorded its limits
why: The independent review found no blocker; localhost results do not cover deployed ingress, durable replay, ownership, or multi-worker delivery
result: ready for discussion and deployment smoke test
